question: Does the component STM32L476RGT6 have flash capabilities according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: The datasheet for the STM32L476RGT6 can be found at http://www.st.com/st-web-ui/static/active/en/resource/technical/document/datasheet/DM00108832.pdf. According to the datasheet, the STM32L476RGT6 has 1024KB of flash memory.
